channel.title: Liwfy & Tico
channel.description:
Let’s Hit 100K Subs Together! 🤖🌱

Welcome to Liwfy, home of Tico, the tiny shy robot with a sprout on his head and the biggest heart! 🥺

Emotional stories, funny stories, chaotic stories... and so much more!

One little robot, a thousand stories.

Thanks for watching and for being part of Tico’s journey! 💙
